intents: Configure dynamic IPv6 reachability with FRRouting IS-IS between r1 and r2.
pc1 already uses 2001:db8:1::2/64 and reaches its router at 2001:db8:1::1.
pc2 already uses 2001:db8:2::2/64 and reaches its router at 2001:db8:2::1.
On r1, configure 2001:db8:1::1/64 on eth1 and 2001:db8:12::1/64 on eth2.
On r2, configure 2001:db8:12::2/64 on eth2 and 2001:db8:2::1/64 on eth1.
Enable IPv6 forwarding on r1 and r2.
Run IS-IS process CORE in FRR, enable it on the router interfaces, advertise the LAN prefixes, and use wide metrics.
Do not modify management connectivity on eth0.

r1: vtysh -c 'configure terminal' -c 'interface eth1' -c 'ipv6 address 2001:db8:1::1/64' -c 'ipv6 router isis CORE' -c 'exit' -c 'interface eth2' -c 'ipv6 address 2001:db8:12::1/64' -c 'ipv6 router isis CORE' -c 'isis network point-to-point' -c 'exit' -c 'router isis CORE' -c 'net 49.0001.0000.0000.0001.00' -c 'is-type level-2-only' -c 'metric-style wide' -c 'topology ipv6-unicast' -c 'redistribute ipv6 connected level-2' -c 'end'
r2: vtysh -c 'configure terminal' -c 'interface eth1' -c 'ipv6 address 2001:db8:2::1/64' -c 'ipv6 router isis CORE' -c 'exit' -c 'interface eth2' -c 'ipv6 address 2001:db8:12::2/64' -c 'ipv6 router isis CORE' -c 'isis network point-to-point' -c 'exit' -c 'router isis CORE' -c 'net 49.0001.0000.0000.0002.00' -c 'is-type level-2-only' -c 'metric-style wide' -c 'topology ipv6-unicast' -c 'redistribute ipv6 connected level-2' -c 'end'

ground_truth_reasoning: The hosts already have IPv6 addresses and static routes toward their local router, so the routers must supply the LAN gateway addresses, enable IPv6 forwarding, and exchange routes dynamically. FRR IS-IS CORE is enabled on each LAN-facing and core-facing interface; the point-to-point core link forms the adjacency, wide metrics and the ipv6-unicast topology are enabled, and connected IPv6 prefixes are redistributed into level 2 so pc1 and pc2 can reach each other without static routes on the routers.
